result.instructions: Tools for HERO Software, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my customers in HERO and show their email and address."; "Which projects are open, and who is the customer of each?"; "Show the documents and log entries of project 150798.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HERO Software data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hero_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hero_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hero_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. hero_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hero_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers and others) with number, name, company, email, phone and address. Filter by category (for example 'customer'). Page with offset. HERO GraphQL query: contacts.

tools.name: hero_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with project number, trade (measure), customer, contact person, project address and status. Pass ids to fetch only some projects. HERO GraphQL query: project_matches.

ids.description: Project ids to fetch. Leave empty for all projects.

tools.name: hero_get_project
tools.title: Get a project with documents and log
tools.description: Get one project by id with its customer documents (type, number, value, file link) and its history entries (log book). HERO GraphQL query: project_matches(ids).

annotations.title: Get a project with documents and log

tools.name: hero_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List customer documents (offers, invoices and so on) with number, date, value, VAT, status, document type and file link. HERO GraphQL query: customer_documents.

tools.name: hero_run_query
tools.title: Run a read-only GraphQL query
tools.description: Run any read-only GraphQL query on the HERO API, for example calendar_events or supply_product_versions, or a schema introspection ({ __schema { queryType { fields { name } } } }). Mutations and subscriptions are refused. The schema is only visible by introspection with your key.
